[P2] Add an integration example for the new execution semantics

The example changes only rename existing enum members; none exercises `AtLeastOnceAsync` or `defaultStepSemantics`. The new composed tests use a client that returns no execution state and never resume an execution, leaving persistence and replay of this public feature untested. Root AGENTS.md Tests rule 3 and CONTRIBUTING.md require example-backed integration coverage for SDK features/API changes. Add an example and integration test covering suspend/resume with inherited asynchronous semantics and an explicit per-step override.
